# netbox_site (Resource)

Manages a NetBox site (`/api/dcim/sites/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_tag" "example" {
  name = "example-tag"
  slug = "example-tag"
}

resource "netbox_site" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  tags = [netbox_tag.example.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full name of the site.
- `slug` (String) Slug.

### Optional

- `asn_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Asn (`netbox_asn`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `facility` (String) Local facility ID or description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `group_id` (Number) ID of the Site Group (`netbox_site_group`).
- `latitude` (Number) GPS coordinate in decimal format (xx.yyyyyy).
- `longitude` (Number) GPS coordinate in decimal format (xx.yyyyyy).
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `physical_address` (String) Physical location of the building. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `region_id` (Number) ID of the Region (`netbox_region`).
- `shipping_address` (String) If different from the physical address. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `planned`, `staging`, `active`, `decommissioning`, `retired`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `time_zone` (String) Time Zone.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_site can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_site.example 123
```
